instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/four_parts.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create four FreeCAD Path/CAM Jobs for four identical parts, using work-coordinate offsets G54, G55, G56, and G57. Apply the same Face and Profile operations to each part. Tool definition: T1 is reused across G54, G55, G56, and G57 with S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-09.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
